## Description

AI proposes source→target column mappings and code mappings (local test names → LOINC, diagnoses → ICD-10, drugs → country formulary); a person approves each mapping once; approved mappings are saved as a template per legacy vendor for reuse.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No mapping is applied without human approval; approvals are recorded with actor and time.
- [ ] **AC2.** Templates can be applied to a new clinic on the same vendor and diffed for changes.
- [ ] **AC3.** Unmapped values are listed for manual decision; nothing is silently dropped.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
